findings.requirement: Plating thickness is allowed for on tight fits and threads

evidence.quote: NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: M.S. # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2 # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.35 kg

findings.comment: Dimension D1 specifies a tight ISO fit (H7) on a part that Note N3 states receives a trivalent zinc plating finish (I.Z.B.P.). The drawing does not indicate that the hole size accounts for the plating thickness or that the hole should be machined after plating, which risks the plated part failing to assemble with its mating pin.
findings.recommended_correction: Add a note specifying that the Ø6 H7 holes are to be machined after plating, or adjust the pre-plate dimension to allow for the specified coating thickness.
